P1Thu Oct 29, 5:00 pm ET2026-10-29 21:00 UTC Evergreen
OddsBossThu Oct 29, 5:00 pm ET · Public

Sportsbooks don't always agree on prices. Arbitrage is when the gap is wide enough to cover both sides. Example: Book A has Over 221.5 total points at +140. Book B has the Under at −125. With $214 on the Over and $286 on the Under ($500 in total), the Over returns $513.60 and the Under returns $514.80, if both bets are placed at these prices. Most gaps are small, usually 3% or less of the stake, and they close fast. OddsBoss scans 17 books and markets, pre-match and live, shows the pair as soon as it opens and works out the stake for each side. You don't need to follow the team, or even the sport. See how it works: https://macaroniidev.github.io/oddsboss/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=page_launch&utm_content=P1#how Example only. Every bet carries risk. 21+ only. Gambling problem? Call 1-800-GAMBLER. OddsBoss is software, not a sportsbook.

Sometimes a sportsbook's price is better than the fair price. Positive EV finds those spots. OddsBoss checks every price against no-vig fair odds and ranks the gaps in real time, pre-match and live. Every bet comes with a Kelly stake, set to your bankroll. The honest part: these are one-sided bets, so you will lose some. The math plays out over hundreds of bets, not in any single one. It's best for anyone willing to open 3+ sportsbook accounts, start with a bankroll of $3,000+ and put in 1+ hour a day. Positive EV is included in Pre-Match Arbitrage & EV, $79.99/mo. 7 days free. Many experienced bettors trade on exchanges like Novig and ProphetX, where every bet is public. When volume spikes on a line there, OddsBoss Sharp Money finds the closest price for the same line at your books and suggests a stake.
